name: Chronominion Idler
detailed_description:
Expand and Preserve Your Territory with Immortal Tiles

In this ever-changing world, land is not just for building—it’s for survival. Immortal Tiles allow you to expand your domain, creating space for new structures while shielding your territory from the relentless decay of the world. Without them, nature reclaims the land, erasing what once stood. Secure your future, build strategically, and ensure that your legacy endures in a world that refuses to stay the same.

A Rich System of Skills, Jobs, and Items

Train your characters in diverse skills and professions, unlocking rare equipment and mastering job-based abilities to gain an edge in combat and exploration. Carefully develop your party to adapt to the challenges ahead, whether through raw strength, tactical finesse, or specialized support roles.

Additionally, the Zodiac system and unique character traits influence each character’s stats and performance, shaping their strengths, weaknesses, and synergy with others. A well-balanced team, with traits and zodiac signs that complement each other, can mean the difference between survival and defeat in this ever-evolving world.

A Living Economy & Crafting System

Trade, build, craft, and manage resources in an economy that fluctuates based on traders' affinities.

In this ever-changing RPG world, time waits for no one. Adapt, strategize, and leave your mark—before the world moves on without you.
